narration: Daniel hurried down the same street every morning. He knew its cracks, its corners, and exactly how long his journey took.
action: Street wide tracking Daniel, teal clothing; bench and Eli ahead.
narration_pt: Daniel percorria apressado a mesma rua todas as manhãs. Conhecia suas rachaduras, suas esquinas e sabia exatamente quanto tempo levava o trajeto.

narration: Today, an older man named Eli stood beside the bench. When his paper bag slipped, bread scattered across the pavement.
action: Medium on Eli, peach clothing; paper bag tips and bread drops.
narration_pt: Naquele dia, um senhor chamado Eli estava ao lado do banco. Quando seu saco de papel escorregou, os pães se espalharam pela calçada.

narration: Daniel saw it happen. He shortened his stride, then looked away. Someone else would stop. Surely someone else had more time.
action: Daniel slows in foreground, glances toward Eli, turns gaze forward, walks past.
narration_pt: Daniel viu o que aconteceu. Encurtou o passo, depois desviou o olhar. Outra pessoa pararia. Certamente outra pessoa teria mais tempo.

narration: But after a few steps, the street grew quiet. Behind him, Eli lowered himself carefully, reaching for bread just beyond his fingers.
action: Low close view of Eli bending and reaching; Daniel recedes.
narration_pt: Mas, depois de alguns passos, a rua ficou silenciosa. Atrás dele, Eli se abaixava com cuidado, tentando alcançar um pão que estava pouco além de seus dedos.

narration: Daniel stopped beside the bench. He remembered words he had heard many times, but had not yet practiced that morning.
action: Daniel stops near far end of bench; shoulder turn and thoughtful look back.
narration_pt: Daniel parou ao lado do banco. Lembrou-se de palavras que ouvira muitas vezes, mas que ainda não havia colocado em prática naquela manhã.

narration: Jesus said, “Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.” Matthew twenty-two, verse thirty-nine. The words asked something simple of him now.
action: Close-up Daniel, then focus toward Eli; small readable verse overlay with reference.
narration_pt: Jesus disse: “Amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo.” Mateus vinte e dois, versículo trinta e nove. Agora, aquelas palavras lhe pediam algo simples.

narration: Daniel turned around. He could not change the whole world before breakfast. But he could return to the person he had passed.
action: Side tracking shot: deliberate turn and return to Eli.
narration_pt: Daniel deu meia-volta. Não poderia mudar o mundo inteiro antes do café da manhã. Mas poderia voltar até a pessoa por quem havia passado.

narration: He approached slowly and asked if Eli would like a hand. Eli nodded. Daniel knelt and gathered the scattered loaves.
action: Two-shot: Daniel open-palm offer, Eli nod; Daniel kneels.
narration_pt: Ele se aproximou devagar e perguntou se Eli gostaria de uma ajuda. Eli assentiu. Daniel se ajoelhou e recolheu os pães espalhados.

narration: Some bread was still wrapped. One piece had fallen loose. Daniel set that piece aside instead of putting it back.
action: Hand/bread insert; two wrapped loaves, one loose piece placed separately on bench edge.
narration_pt: Alguns pães ainda estavam embalados. Um pedaço havia caído sem embalagem. Daniel separou aquele pedaço, em vez de colocá-lo de volta.

narration: Together, they opened the bag. Eli steadied it while Daniel placed the wrapped bread inside. Neither needed to hurry now.
action: Close two-shot hands: Eli holds bag open; Daniel places wrapped loaves inside.
narration_pt: Juntos, eles abriram o saco. Eli o segurou firme enquanto Daniel colocava os pães embalados dentro. Agora, nenhum dos dois precisava ter pressa.

narration: Daniel offered to carry the bag. Eli accepted, then pointed down the street. They began walking together, at Eli’s pace.
action: Daniel lifts bag with Eli’s assent; Eli points, both begin walking.
narration_pt: Daniel se ofereceu para carregar o saco. Eli aceitou e apontou adiante na rua. Começaram a caminhar juntos, no ritmo de Eli.

narration: The journey took longer than Daniel had planned. Yet for once, he noticed the warmth of the morning along the way.
action: Side medium tracking their matched steps and warm light.
narration_pt: O trajeto demorou mais do que Daniel havia planejado. Ainda assim, dessa vez, ele percebeu o calor da manhã pelo caminho.

narration: Loving a neighbour had not required a grand speech. It had begun with noticing, turning back, and offering help without taking over.
action: Reverse medium: Daniel slows slightly to remain alongside Eli; exchanged small smiles.
narration_pt: Amar o próximo não havia exigido um grande discurso. Tudo começara ao perceber, voltar e oferecer ajuda sem assumir o controle.

narration: That morning, Daniel arrived late. But he understood something he had almost walked past: love becomes visible in the next kind thing we do.
action: Wide rear view both continuing down street, gentle camera rise; hold final 2 seconds.
narration_pt: Naquela manhã, Daniel chegou atrasado. Mas compreendeu algo que quase havia deixado para trás: o amor se torna visível no próximo gesto de bondade que fazemos.
